usedFor: Libraria AI answers questions from your library, and “Create Query” returns a response to a query.

bestTemplate.name: “New Message Posted in Channel Instant” in Slack, then “Create Query” in Libraria AI
bestTemplate.why: A question posted in a channel becomes a query, and the response comes from your own library.

watchOut: A response that goes on to someone outside your team waits in Needs you for your approval.
